duzeltme.giris:
Duckweed is a small water plant that can quickly cover the surface of a pond. A biologist measures the area of a pond that is covered by duckweed. On day 4 the covered area is 30 square meters, and on day 10 the covered area is 120 square meters.

The covered area, in square meters, \(t\) days after the biologist starts the study can be modeled by the function \(A\) given by \(A(t) = a \cdot b^{t}\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are positive constants. The total area of the pond's surface is 500 square meters.

A graphing calculator is required for some parts of this question. Give decimal answers correct to three places after the decimal point.
duzeltme.parcalar[1].rubrik[0].olcut: (i) \(A(14)\approx302.381\) metrekare (ara değerleri üç ondalığa yuvarlamaktan gelen 302.3–302.7 arası kabul; birimle).
duzeltme.parcalar[2].rubrik[0].ornek_cevap: Solving \(a\cdot b^{t}=500\) with \(b=4^{1/6}\) and \(a=30/4^{2/3}\) gives \(t\approx16.177\) days.
